findings.issue: TC-02 to TC-10 were remapped away from the criteria they test (e.g. pipeline test to AC3, alerts to AC7). TC-09 and TC-10 point to AC9/AC10, which did not exist.
New criterion numbered AC11 after AC8, skipping AC9 and AC10. Renumbered to AC9, and TC-21 updated.
New criterion numbered AC12 leaves a numbering gap. Renumbered to AC10, and TC-22 updated.
The new criterion says every alert carries a message ID, but section 14 says PUBLISHED NO and failed-run conditions have none.
TC-07 still expects the legacy text, although MSG-P1-001 now carries the Error and Message Standard v4 text.
Size is still not given, only recorded as not specified, so the readiness failure is not resolved.
